title: LLM Evaluation Measurement Integrity: Reproducibility Package
description: Deterministic code, frozen figure data, empirical derived artifacts, manifests and reproducibility documentation accompanying the manuscript “Evaluation infrastructure can distort behavioral effects in language-model experiments”. OMI is the manuscript's short label for the audited contextual-provenance empirical case. The package separates exact analytic results, deterministic synthetic sensitivity surfaces, validation simulations and frozen empirical results.
